short_description: Basal cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer that often appears as a slow-growing bump, shiny lesion, or sore that does not heal. It usually grows slowly but needs medical treatment.
temporary_advice: Do not scratch or pick the lesion
Protect the area from sun exposure
avoid: Do not ignore a wound that does not heal
Do not try to remove it yourself
risk_notes: Basal cell carcinoma is usually slow-growing but it is a cancerous lesion and requires medical diagnosis and treatment.
when_to_see_doctor: If a sore does not heal
If a lesion bleeds or crusts repeatedly
If a bump grows slowly over time
If the lesion changes color or shape
